questions.question: The remaining people of Judah asked Jeremiah to pray to the LORD. What did they want the LORD to tell them?

answers.text: The way to walk and what to do
How long Babylon will rule them
Who their next governor will be

questions.question: The LORD told the remnant of Judah through Jeremiah not to fear the king of Babylon. What reason did He give?

answers.text: He is with them to save them
The king's army has gone home
The king has made peace with them

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD warned the remnant of Judah not to go live in which land?
Jeremiah told the remnant of Judah that they had obeyed the voice of the LORD in everything He sent him to say. True or false?
